name: América Móvil, S.A.B. de C.V.
summary: América Móvil, S.A.B. de C.V. provides telecommunications services in Latin America and internationally. It offers wireless and fixed-line voice services, including airtime, local, domestic, and international long-distance services; and network interconnection services.
